options: A type of keel used on fishing vessels
A shroud round the propeller that adds thrust at low speed
A valve fitted to the sea chest
A fuel filter for high-speed engines
questions.explanation: It improves bollard pull, which is why tugs use it.

options: A type of anchor stowed in the hull
The deck filler for the fuel tanks
A storage locker for engine tools
A recess in the hull that supplies sea water
questions.explanation: It usually has a grating and a way to clear it.

options: Cools the fuel in the day tank
Strains seaweed out of the raw water
Cools engine fresh water in pipes outside the hull
Cools the cabin through the deckhead
questions.explanation: No raw-water intake is needed, so there is less fouling and corrosion inside the engine.

options: Is only fitted to sailing vessels
Has blade pitch that cannot be changed in service
Can be adjusted from the bridge at sea
Has its blades bolted on so they can be swapped at sea

questions.stem: Seacocks should be operated regularly because:
options: Moving them cools the engine room
They can seize open and fail to close when needed
Moving them warms the bilge water
The rules say seacocks must be painted every single year
questions.explanation: A seized valve cannot isolate a failed hose.

questions.stem: The engine overheats and the raw-water pump is turning normally. A likely cause is:
options: A blocked sea strainer, such as with kelp
A full fuel tank adding weight
A clean heat exchanger
Low oil in the gearbox
questions.explanation: Weed or jellyfish in the strainer restricts the flow of cooling water.

questions.stem: Before opening a sea strainer that sits below the waterline you must:
options: Start the bilge pump
Remove the zinc anode
Close the seacock
Open the drain on the fuel tank
questions.explanation: Otherwise sea water will flood in when the lid comes off.

questions.stem: A sacrificial anode protects a propeller by:
options: Insulating the propeller from the water
Corroding instead of it, as the more reactive metal
Making the water around it less salty
Cleaning marine growth from the blades
questions.explanation: The anode is the weaker metal in the galvanic pair and wastes away instead of the propeller.

questions.stem: You should not paint a sacrificial anode because:
options: It would add weight to the hull
The colour would affect the compass
Paint stops contact with the water, so it cannot protect
Anodes must be left bright for inspection
questions.explanation: An anode must be bare metal to work.

questions.stem: A rubber hose on an overboard fitting bursts and water floods in. A prompt action is to:
options: Close the seacock or plug the opening, and tell the master
Open all the other seacocks to balance the flow
Switch off the bilge pump to save battery power for later
Tighten the stern gland to slow the leak
questions.explanation: Stop the water at the hull opening first, then call the master and use the pumps.
